verdict.rationale: Better Stack's status page docs advertise 'SSO, password, and IP protection. Create a private status page for internal teams or enterprise customers'. Its getting-started guide documents password protection for private status pages, so private pages for employee-only or customer-specific audiences with access control are directly claimed. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on SSO/IP restriction setup for status pages, per-customer audience segmentation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
